generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: sequential unique integers starting at 1, no NULL
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: sample from parent key pool; include NULL when column nullable; include at least one child row whose FK has no matching parent when the column is nullable
generic_sampling_rules.int_numeric: uniform integer within the range rule; include boundary values and one step on each side of each listed literal
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: pick from a small pool of realistic values; allow near-duplicate variants (case, spacing, punctuation) when no constraint forbids it
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: pick from a pool of person/place names; allow near-duplicate variants
generic_sampling_rules.text_theme: pick from a pool of short descriptive phrases; allow near-duplicate variants
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: with probability equal to the compact database null share emit NULL, otherwise a non-NULL value; at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance
generic_sampling_rules.enum_small: uniform choice among the listed enum values
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: ensure at least two rows share the same value at the listed ORDER rank
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_distinct: ensure the duplicate share of distinct values falls in the listed range
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_values: about 20% of text values are fresh variants not present in the original rows
